method: Manual review of live GitHub exact PR heads, base comparisons, check conclusions, review status, patch contents, and worktree/lane inventories; followed by closeout, after-task structure, prose lint, JSON, and diff checks.
coverage: Whole report by continuity from v19; reread the 2026-11-02 12:12 UTC owner-attributed route map and current base-to-main comparisons.
score_reason: The report uses exact files, SHAs, run IDs, and explicit limits. Some technical sentences are dense, but the PR status is separated into short bullets.
confidence_reason: GitHub exposed current PR metadata and check runs; compare endpoints confirmed the five-commit Julia and four-commit R main advances; local worktree lists and preflight exposed the detached R #1659 checkout and active owner lanes. No code or model fits were run.

science_gate_reason: This report records a documentation reconciliation, not a new scientific result.
facts_gate_reason: Exact PR source heads and bases, current main SHAs, ahead counts, check outcomes, patch-level test details, and the detached clean R fixture worktree were verified from GitHub and local Git inventories. The route map labels historical or conditional evidence and states owner holds and missing gates.
references_gate_reason: The linked PRs and workflow runs refer to the exact items checked during this refresh; no unsupported external scientific references were added.
calibration_status: No style controls were used; this is an uncalibrated editorial judgment.
